title: V5 Master Research Plan — Biology-Grounded Under-40 Rescue and Macro-F1 Improvement
target_venue: IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (TMI) / Medical Image Analysis (MedIA)
executive_summary: V5 shifts the research paradigm from post-hoc demographic rules (proven in V4 S64-S67 to redistribute referrals without generating ranking capability) to visual and morphological representation learning. Grounded in the biology of dermatoscopic structures (atypical pigment networks, pseudopods, negative network, shiny white lines), V5 couples high-resolution dual-stream extraction (384px), Group-DRO, and morphological multi-task supervision to break the under-40 melanoma ranking ceiling without test-set snooping.

integrity_rules.zero_leakage: Lesion-grouped splitting enforced by assert_no_leakage; zero patient/lesion overlap between train, val, and test splits.
integrity_rules.oof_parameter_fitting: All calibrators, threshold multipliers, and loss weights fitted strictly on out-of-fold cross-validation predictions.
integrity_rules.val_only_selection: Model selection and early stopping decided on validation metrics; held-out test split evaluated exactly once post-freeze.
integrity_rules.fresh_cohort_discipline: Reserved cohort (read 8 times across V4) is retired from confirmatory claims; S75 fresh external cohort evaluated once post-freeze.

melanoma.biological_hallmarks: Atypical pigment network (thickened, branched lines ending abruptly), irregular dots/globules irregularly clustered at periphery, pseudopods / radial streaming indicating horizontal growth phase, blue-white veil (orthokeratosis over dense melanin clusters), shiny white crystalline lines (stromal collagen alteration under polarized light), regression structures (fibrosis with peppering), polymorphous / dotted atypical vascular structures.
melanoma.young_melanoma_morphology: Frequently presents as superficial spreading melanoma (SSM) or amelanotic/hypomelanotic variants with high nevus association. Lacks large blue-white veils or ulceration; characterized by subtle focal network disruptions, delicate pseudopods, negative pigment network, and faint erythematous backgrounds easily downsampled away.

melanocytic_nevus.biological_hallmarks: Symmetric, uniform architectural organization. Regular pigment network with lines thinning toward the perimeter, central cobblestone or uniform globules, homogenous light-to-dark brown pigmentation, distinct absence of polymorphous vessels or atypical branching lines.

basal_cell_carcinoma.biological_hallmarks: Non-melanocytic malignant basaloid proliferations. Absence of melanin pigment network. Hallmark structures: sharp arborizing (tree-like) telangiectasias, multiple blue-gray ovoid nests, spoke-wheel areas, leaf-like peripheral structures, shiny white-red structureless background with focal ulceration.

actinic_keratosis.biological_hallmarks: Keratinocyte dysplasia. Erythematous background pseudo-network with white halos around follicular openings ('strawberry pattern'), distinct four-dot white rosette structures under polarized dermoscopy, prominent superficial white/yellow hyperkeratotic scaling.

benign_keratosis.biological_hallmarks: Epidermal proliferations. Seborrheic keratosis: milia-like cysts ('starry sky'), comedo-like openings, cerebriform fissure-and-ridge pattern, sharply demarcated moth-eaten borders, hairpin vessels with white halos. Lichenoid keratosis: coarse granular gray-blue peppering across the entire lesion.

dermatofibroma.biological_hallmarks: Benign fibrohistiocytic proliferation. Pathognomonic central white patch (fibrous scar-like core) surrounded by a delicate, regular, fading peripheral pigment network; negative pigment network occasionally present. Clinically dimples on lateral pinch.

vascular_lesions.biological_hallmarks: Ectatic blood vessels and hemangiomas. Distinct red, purple, or blue-black lacunae (lagunes) separated by pale fibrous septa. Total absence of melanocytic pigment networks.

foundation.name: 384px Input Resolution Foundation
foundation.description: Establish 384x384 resolution across all training runs; lock 24-view TTA, soft-voting, Dirichlet calibration, and leak-free lesion-grouped splits.

foundation.name: Dual-Stream Global (384px) + Lesion-Centered Local Crop (384px)
foundation.description: Extract full global frame alongside automated lesion-centered 1:1 resolution crop; fuse via late cross-attention.

foundation.name: Group-DRO & Subgroup Supervised Contrastive Loss
foundation.description: Optimize worst-case group risk across G = {age_band x escalation} to prevent majority cohorts from suppressing young melanoma gradients.

foundation.name: 384px Modern Heterogeneous Backbones
foundation.description: Fine-tune ConvNeXt-V2 (with Global Response Normalization), SwinV2-384, and EfficientNetV2-M at 384px with cosine schedule.
foundation.primary_endpoint: Ensemble diversity Yule Q < 0.70 & individual val Macro-F1 >= 0.740

foundation.name: S75 Fresh External Cohort Sourcing & Lock
foundation.description: Source and deduplicate pristine external dataset with patient age; lock for single post-freeze confirmatory read.
foundation.primary_endpoint: Single confirmatory execution on fresh cohort

biology_grounded.name: Morphology Feature Audit across Age Strata
biology_grounded.description: Extract quantitative dermatological morphology descriptors (asymmetry, border compactness, color entropy, network density) across HAM and ISIC-2019.
biology_grounded.primary_endpoint: Statistical significance (p < 0.01) of young vs old melanoma morphology differences

biology_grounded.name: Auxiliary Multi-Task Morphology Heads
biology_grounded.description: Supervise shared visual trunk with auxiliary heads predicting presence of atypical network, pseudopods, and blue-white veil.

biology_grounded.name: Local Morphology Patch Mining
biology_grounded.description: Biologically guided patch extraction targeting peripheral growth borders, eccentric hyperpigmentation, and vascular zones.

biology_grounded.name: Segmentation-Guided Multi-Region ROI Pipeline
biology_grounded.description: Automated U-Net++ segmentation generating core interior, boundary transition ring, and outer context crops.
biology_grounded.primary_endpoint: Macro-F1 and under-40 pAUC vs full-frame control

biology_grounded.name: Boundary-Ring Network
biology_grounded.description: Tri-stream representation f = f_interior + f_boundary + f_context targeting border irregularity and radial streaming.

biology_grounded.name: Trainable Mel vs. Nevus Fine-Grained Representation Branch
biology_grounded.description: End-to-end trainable visual sub-network with dedicated intermediate feature layers for the Mel-vs-Nevus decision boundary.
biology_grounded.primary_endpoint: Melanoma recall gain >= +0.05 at fixed 85% specificity

biology_grounded.name: Biologically Constrained Hard-Negative Metric Learning
biology_grounded.description: Supervised contrastive / triplet loss forcing margin between melanoma and dysplastic nevi, dermatofibromas, and pigmented BCC.

biology_grounded.name: Frequency / High-Pass Wavelet (DWT) Texture Branch
biology_grounded.description: Concatenate 2D Discrete Wavelet Transform sub-bands into parallel convolutional stem to feed high-frequency pigment reticulation directly.

biology_grounded.name: Radial / Polar Centroid-Normalized Representation
biology_grounded.description: Transform segmented lesion to polar coordinates I(r, theta) to linearize peripheral growth pseudopods and radial streaming.

biology_grounded.name: Morphology-Gated Multi-Expert Ensemble
biology_grounded.description: Mixture-of-experts routing image to specialized branches based on visual morphology encoder (reticular vs globular vs structureless) without direct age feeding.

corrections.name: Corrected von Kries Colour Constancy
corrections.description: Re-evaluate corrected gain = ||e|| / (sqrt(3) * e_c) across Grey World, Max-RGB, and Shades-of-Grey under 384px resolution.

corrections.name: Un-Truncated EMA & Cosine Schedule
corrections.description: Full 40-epoch cosine schedule with early stopping disabled to properly evaluate Exponential Moving Average weight smoothing.

gate1_representation.threshold: +0.030 improvement over 384px control with 95% bootstrap CI excluding zero
gate1_representation.action_on_fail: Halt architecture development; do not promote model to ensemble

gate2_global_quality.threshold: Macro-F1 >= Control - 0.010 (no unacceptable general accuracy sacrifice)

gate3_complementarity.threshold: Yule Q < 0.70 against existing ensemble members; Disagreement D > 0.08
gate3_complementarity.action_on_fail: Do not add redundant model to ensemble

gate5_external_transport.metric: Under-40 escalation sensitivity on S75 fresh external cohort
gate5_external_transport.threshold: Sensitivity >= 0.80 at matched referral workload; MCID >= 0.05

compute_and_hardware_profile.gpu: NVIDIA RTX 5050 Laptop GPU (8.55 GB VRAM, sm_120)
